description: Raw SQL is avoided unless there is no LINQ-expressible alternative (e.g., a specific PostgreSQL feature with a clear, material performance or capability benefit); when used, it is isolated in Infrastructure, documented, and reviewed — per 00MASTERSPEC.md § 10.7 SQL Injection Prevention, any raw SQL is always parameterized.
